topics.name: time-series
topics.description: 时间序列预测与表征学习：基础模型（TSFM）、长程依赖建模、多变量与协变量 建模、不规则/缺失采样、概率预测与不确定性量化。
topics.avoid: 纯金融量化策略与回测、纯信号处理硬件实现、单一垂直行业的应用报告 （如仅在某个电网数据集上调参且无方法贡献）。
topics.description_en: Time-series forecasting and representation learning: foundation models (TSFM), long-range dependencies, multivariate and covariate modelling, irregular or missing sampling, probabilistic forecasting and uncertainty quantification.
topics.avoid_en: Pure quantitative-finance strategies and backtests, signal-processing hardware, and single-vertical application reports with no methodological contribution (e.g. tuning on one grid dataset).

topics.name: agent
topics.description: 基于大模型的智能体：工具调用与函数执行、长程规划与任务分解、多智能体 协作与通信协议、记忆机制、与环境/代码库/操作系统的交互，以及相应的 评测基准。
topics.avoid: 传统强化学习中不涉及语言模型的 multi-agent RL、纯博弈论理论分析、 仅做 prompt 微调的经验性报告。
topics.description_en: LLM-based agents: tool and function calling, long-horizon planning and task decomposition, multi-agent collaboration and communication protocols, memory mechanisms, interaction with environments, codebases and operating systems, and the benchmarks that evaluate them.
topics.avoid_en: Classical multi-agent RL with no language model involved, purely game-theoretic analysis, and empirical reports that only tune prompts.
